notes: The page's running header reads 'CS Web and Mobile Full-Stack (Certificate of Achievement)', but the requirements read here are under the heading 'CS Web and Mobile Front-End NC' (the Noncredit Certificate of Completion described in the program description).

The award is counted in hours: 'Requirement - complete 157.5 hours' and 'Complete 3 courses (157.50 hours)'. Each course prints 0 in the 'Hours/Units' column, which reflects noncredit units, not hours; per-course hours are not printed, so course units are left null.
The general certificate policy text (residence, scholarship, Policy 3.2) is college-wide boilerplate and not program-specific requirements.
The 'All of the following requirements' language applies to all three courses; the block is recorded as 'all'.
